reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how music transitions in Provincia. No more abrupt cuts! Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a seamless experience as you move through day, night, and combat beds. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

posts: Exciting news for Provincia! We've enhanced our music system to eliminate those jarring transitions. Discover how we're achieving smoother audio experiences in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
